Greta, saw PandaDoc's CEO transition this year and the Denario acquisition consolidating document and payment workflows.

Most RevOps teams have the signals but can't move them to action fast enough, so good-fit accounts go cold before a rep reaches them. Tightening that loop is usually the cheapest pipeline lift available, especially mid-transition.

Worth 15 minutes? I'll walk you through a teardown of your current outbound and three things I'd change. Our best practices alone usually lift response rates 50 to 70 percent.

Want to grab time so I can walk you through how PandaDoc's reply rate compares to other SaaS companies at your scale? I pulled a quick benchmark.
